claims.text: Guardian (11 Sep 2013), memorandum agreed in principle March 2009: NSA shares raw unfiltered phone/internet data with Israel including US citizens' communications; NSA not required to remove US persons' data; no limits on Israel's use reported; Israel must 'destroy upon recognition' communications of US government officials (executive, Congress, federal courts); NSA: handled under procedures 'designed to protect privacy rights'.

NSA 2013 document: 'far-reaching technical and analytic relationship' with ISNU (Unit 8200), 'a dedicated communications line between NSA and ISNU [that] supports the exchange of raw material'; Israel 'enjoys the benefits of expanded geographic access' and 'gains controlled access to advanced U.S. technology and equipment'; Israeli priorities include 'Palestinian terrorism'. 2003–04 'Gladiator' receipts for $500,000 cash payments to Israeli officials, deal apparently never consummated.

NSA 2008 document (Intercept 2015): Israel 'also targets us'; a National Intelligence Estimate ranked Israel third most aggressive intelligence service against the US; 2013 budget document lists Israel among hostile intelligence services/cyber threats; Netanyahu's office (24 Mar 2015): 'The state of Israel does not conduct espionage against the United States or Israel's other allies.'
